messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: Elevated 429 rate on /v1/generate across multiple orgs. Alert: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/alerts/5487
sre-oncall: Investigating — spike started ~2026-03-18T09:50Z. 429s correlate with quota-enforcer v1.7 responses
kai: Any recent console or control-plane changes that touch per-org defaults? @ana?
deploy-bot: deploy started by ana — console-web v2.13.1 -> prod (feature flag: quota-defaults)
nana: typo in deploy-bot message above; ignore
ana: (sorry) I shipped a small console change to add a "default grace tokens" field to the UI. I thought backend had a safe default but I left the UI default as 0.
sre-oncall: That matches what we're seeing — burst allowance for many orgs showing 0, so steady-rate only = immediate 429s when clients exceed base rate
lem: Can we hotpatch control plane to override zero to a sane fallback while we roll back the console change?
kai: I'm patching now: setting control-plane fallback to 16 grace tokens and rolling to a small subset (us-west) first
ana: I will remove the UI default and add migration to bump any newly-created orgs after the rollout
jordan: CS: we're getting ~6 tickets from mid-market customers. Please share ETA on mitigation so SEs can update customers
sre-oncall: Mitigation applied at 1778003000 — metrics show 429 rate returned to baseline within ~90s. Continuing to monitor
ana: Opening PR with tests and UI guardrail now. Also adding an explicit deploy-gate for quota-related UI changes. My apologies. :facepalm:
lem: Postmortem: add an integration test that validates new UI defaults don't diverge from control-plane expectations; add a telemetry alert for sudden drop in burst_allowance per-org
ops-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: 429 spike mitigated, control-plane fallback in place
sre-oncall: Follow-up action items: (#1) revert console default in staging and prod, (#2) run migration to backfill affected orgs, (#3) add unit/integration tests, (#4) postmortem doc and customer outreach plan
ana: I'll take #1 and #3. Kai/lem can you own #2? Jordan will coordinate customer comms.
ops-bot: Notifying incident-channel and creating ticket INC-2026-5487 for the postmortem.
